content: When is a Read View created under READ COMMITTED versus REPEATABLE READ?
I am not sure. What is the rule again?
Under RC a new Read View is created for each consistent read, while under RR the first consistent read generally establishes the Read View reused by later consistent reads in the transaction.
Given that rule, what happens if another transaction commits between two RR snapshot reads?
The second read keeps using the earlier Read View, so it does not see the newly committed version.
